extensionName.message: Shorts Flow: Auto-Scroll for YouTube Shorts
extensionName.description: Full extension name shown in the browser and on the stores. Keep "for YouTube Shorts": never suggest YouTube made Shorts Flow.

extensionShortName.description: Short extension name, also the toolbar button tooltip.

extensionDescription.message: Watch YouTube Shorts hands-free: Shorts Flow moves to the next Short when the current one finishes. Not affiliated with YouTube.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and on the stores (at most 132 characters).

popupTitle.description: Document title and heading of the Popup, the panel that opens from the toolbar icon.

popupVersion.description: Accessible name of the version chip in the Popup's header.

popupWhatsNewUnread.description: Accessible name of the dot on the Popup's version chip, shown after an update until the viewer opens What's new.

popupAutoScroll.description: Name of the Auto-Scroll switch: Shorts Flow moves to the next Short when the current one ends.

popupAutoScrollOn.message: Moves on when a Short ends
popupAutoScrollOn.description: Under the Auto-Scroll switch while it is on.

popupAutoScrollOff.message: Each Short loops until you swipe
popupAutoScrollOff.description: Under the Auto-Scroll switch while it is off.

popupOnShortsFeed.description: Status line: the tab the Popup opened over is on the Shorts Feed, so Shorts Flow is at work there.

popupOffShortsFeed.description: Status line: the tab the Popup opened over is not on the Shorts Feed, so Shorts Flow does nothing there.

popupHostAccessLost.description: Firefox only: heading of the notice shown when the viewer turned off Shorts Flow's access to youtube.com.

popupHostAccessHint.message: Its access to youtube.com is turned off, so it can't move Shorts on.
popupHostAccessHint.description: Firefox only: explains the notice about access to youtube.com.

popupHostAccessRestore.description: Firefox only: button that asks Firefox to give Shorts Flow its access to youtube.com back.

popupSettings.description: Accessible name of the Popup's list of settings.

popupShortsControlShown.description: Popup switch: whether the Shorts Control, Shorts Flow's Auto-Scroll button beside each Short on YouTube, is shown.

popupShortsControlShownHint.message: An Auto-Scroll button beside each Short
popupShortsControlShownHint.description: Under the "Show button on Shorts" switch: what the button is.

popupWhatsNew.description: Popup link to news about recent versions on the Shorts Flow website.

popupReportProblem.description: Popup link to the Report Page on the Shorts Flow website.

popupSupport.description: Popup link to the Support Page on the Shorts Flow website, to rate, share or donate.

stallNotice.description: Stall notice: a small toast on the Shorts Feed when Shorts Flow asked YouTube for the next Short and none came. Keep it short and calm.

stallRetry.description: Button on the Stall notice that asks YouTube for the next Short again.

shortsControlName.description: Shorts Control: name of the Auto-Scroll button Shorts Flow adds to YouTube's row of buttons beside each Short, shown under it like YouTube's "Share". Keep it very short: it has about 64 px.

shortsControlTurnOff.description: Shorts Control: tooltip while Auto-Scroll is on, saying what a click does.

shortsControlTurnOn.description: Shorts Control: tooltip while Auto-Scroll is off, saying what a click does.
